<div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto">
 <p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;1.01. Entry Into a Material Definitive Agreement. </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Agreements with Corteva, Inc. </span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">At 12:03 a.m., New York City time, on October&#160;1, 2026 (the &#8220;Effective Time&#8221;), Corteva, Inc. (&#8220;Corteva&#8221;) completed its previously announced separation into two independent, publicly traded companies through the separation (&#8220;Separation&#8221;) of Corteva&#8217;s seed operating segment into an independent, publicly traded company, Vylor Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;). The Separation was effected through a pro rata distribution of all of the outstanding shares of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of the Company (&#8220;Company common stock&#8221;) to holders of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of Corteva as of the close of business on September&#160;24, 2026 (the &#8220;Distribution&#8221;). </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">As a result of the Distribution, the Company became an independent, publicly traded company. Company common stock commenced <span style="white-space:nowrap">regular-way</span> trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;VYLR&#8221; on October&#160;1, 2026. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In connection with the Separation, on September&#160;29, 2026, Corteva, the Company and, solely for specified purposes, EIDP, Inc. entered into a Separation and Distribution Agreement, and on October&#160;1, 2026, Corteva and/or certain of its affiliates entered into certain agreements with the Company and/or certain of its affiliates, including each of the following: </p> <p style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

A description of the material provisions of the Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation and the Amended and Restated Bylaws can be found in the Information Statement under the section entitled &#8220;Description of Our Capital Stock&#8221;, which description is incorporated by reference into this Item 5.03. The forward-looking statements involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause actual results to be materially different from any results, levels of activity, performance or achievements expressed or implied by any forward-looking statement. These statements are qualified by reference to the &#8220;Risk Factors&#8221; and &#8220;Cautionary Statement Concerning Forward-Looking Statements&#8221; sections (and similar risk factors and cautionary statements) in all reports and forms filed by the Company with the SEC. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company wishes to caution readers not to place undue reliance on any such forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the date made.
